integration_issues.issue: UI waits ~60s then shows 'Unable to generate F&O projections'; no Top 4 cards rendered because /api/fno/generate returns 502.

action_items: Fix /api/fno/generate 502 on public preview URL (normal and custom_script path).
After F&O fix, retest end-to-end: generate -> dual panes -> stock opportunities count -> top4 -> custom script result card.
Keep portfolio upload parser coverage (csv/txt/xlsx alias headers) and dynamic stock-signal non-cap regression test in CI.
critical_code_review_comments: F&O endpoint likely overloaded/externally fragile: /api/fno/generate performs three heavy async builds (NIFTY pane, BANKNIFTY pane, stock universe) in a single request and currently surfaces 502 at ingress/client.
UI correctly surfaces generic F&O failure but does not show backend detail; adding surfaced error detail/code would speed RCA during outages.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Latest pytest run: 13 passed, 2 failed (both /api/fno/generate related). New structured test file validates manual portfolio horizons (1W/1M/3M/6M/9M/1Y), upload parsing for txt/csv/xlsx flexible headers, and method-level dynamic stock F&O signal list not hard-capped to 3.
rca of the issue: Repro: login owner (@shish123) -> POST /api/fno/generate {} or {custom_script:'NIFTY10MAR24050PE'} -> HTTP 502 from public endpoint. UI repro: F&O page -> Generate button remains 'Generating...' for ~60s, then shows 'Unable to generate F&O projections', with zero top4 cards. Supporting evidence: Playwright console captured network error 502 on /api/fno/generate. Mitigation direction: add timing instrumentation around _build_index_projection/_build_stock_fno_signals + upstream market-data calls, then reduce latency/failure blast radius (timeouts/fallbacks/circuit-breaker/partial response strategy).
